selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed curl package at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: The exact version lock is active. DNF reports no curl update with the lock enabled, although curl 8.12.1 is available when the plugin is disabled. After restart, curl remains 8.9.1-5.el10 and the lock remains active.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, the node reports RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID 03273aa8-4706-4e1c-a855-c6ae9635951d was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID 5fbf3c8d-55ee-4625-9c7e-b3e7df9bdb3a. Post-restart state was running; curl integrity, runtime, package version, plugin, and lock all verified successfully.
